The Dip: A Little Book That Teaches You When to Quit (and When to Stick) (2007) is the tenth published book by former dot com executive Seth Godin . [ 1 ] It is a 76 page book that illustrates the concept of "the dip"—a temporary setback that can be overcome with persistence—and how to recognize if the reader is within one worth pushing through or one where they should quit.

Background

[ edit ]
The rough idea for The Dip first materialized on Godin's blog. [ 2 ] On an entry titled "The four curves
